reviews.body:
Nice work!
I noticed that the Gemini example in docs/source/llm.rst:151 still uses gemini-2.0-flash. Please update it. 
Also, both Vertex examples in docs/source/user_guide_rag.rst and several examples in examples/customize/ use gemini-2.5-flash which is retired. Please update them too.

review_comments.body: I think temperature, top_k and top_p are ignored on 3.8 Flash and replaced by thinking_level. Please verify and adjust the example.
if my point was correct, please make sure to reflect it in CHANGELOG too.
Nit: Add assert 'Defaults to "gemini-3.8-flash"' in (GeminiLLM.__doc__ or "")
